input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: Auto-mode classifier denied installing the online-fdr wheel (BSD-3) into system Python and into a scratch venv, so it could not be run as an oracle; replaced with an independent Python implementation from the papers' formulas.
SAFFRON constant first hard-coded to 10 digits; the 1e-12 reference test caught it and it was set to scipy's full 1/zeta(1.6).

doc_friction.issue: Pinned engine.mjs as import-free and required the exact '<label for="id">' string, so adding a sibling module or an id on a label failed tests unrelated to correctness; loosened to allow only ./online.mjs.
Merges the module's DEFAULTS (method 'bh') into every call, including a second entry point (analyzeOnline) with its own method set; analyzeOnline now treats a batch method id as 'no choice'.

deviations.why: Running a downloaded PyPI package as a reference oracle was blocked by the permission classifier.
deviations.did: Wrote eval/online_reference.py, a structurally different second implementation, and verified citations by web search instead.
deviations.result: 13,680 levels agree to 1e-12; the oracle is independent code but not a third-party implementation, which the README states.

notes: Explore idea: online FDR control (research-tools candidate list) as a mode of fdr-multiple-testing: LOND, LORD++, SAFFRON, alpha-spending. Verified against an independent Python implementation (13,680 levels to 1e-12) and a seeded simulation (all rules FDR < 0.05; SAFFRON power 0.875 vs batch BH 0.835 at 50% effects; LORD++ actual FDR ~0.01). Side finding: the conventional LORD gamma constant 0.07720838 sums to 0.9763, not 1 (closed-form tail). Local checks: run_venture_tests fdr-multiple-testing 50/50; Playwright page drive with no console errors; check_post_links 0 broken; run_workflow_locally --for-changes output below if complete.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a statistician implementing and cross-checking three online FDR rules, a page mode, CLI, simulation and write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
